title: Rethinking Arrow--Debreu: A New Framework for Exchange
abstract: arXiv:2510.16003v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper revisits the Arrow--Debreu general equilibrium framework through the lens of effective trade, emphasizing the distinction between theoretical and realizable market interactions. We develop the Effective Trade Model (ETM), where transactions arise from bilateral feasibility rather than aggregate supply and demand desires. Within this framework, we establish the main properties of the price-demand correspondence and prove the existence of Nash equilibria, incorporating production, money, and network topology. Our results show that equilibrium is shaped by transaction constraints, subjective pricing, and decentralized negotiation, rather than by universal market-clearing conditions, and thereby call into question the foundations of welfare theory.

translated_title: 重新思考阿罗-德布鲁：一个新的交换框架
translated_abstract: 本文通过有效贸易的视角重新审视阿罗-德布鲁一般均衡框架，强调理论市场交互与可实现市场交互之间的区别。我们提出了有效贸易模型（ETM），其中交易源于双边可行性，而非总供给和总需求意愿。在该框架内，我们建立了价格-需求对应的主要性质，并证明了纳什均衡的存在性，同时纳入了生产、货币和网络拓扑结构。我们的结果表明，均衡是由交易约束、主观定价和去中心化谈判塑造的，而非由普适的市场出清条件决定，从而对福利理论的基础提出了质疑。
tldr: 本文提出有效贸易模型（ETM），以双边可行交易取代总供需出清来重构阿罗-德布鲁一般均衡框架，证明了纳入生产、货币与网络拓扑后的纳什均衡存在性，并由此质疑了基于市场出清条件的福利理论基础。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Effective Trade Model (ETM), which reconstructs the Arrow-Debreu general equilibrium framework based on bilateral feasible transactions rather than aggregate supply-demand clearing, proves the existence of Nash equilibria incorporating production, money, and network topology, and thereby calls into question the foundations of welfare theory.
